integrity: Proof reconstructed from cyclic mechanical-word prefix estimates, rational tongue theorem and analytic inversion. Accompanying finite exact checks supplement, but do not establish, the general theorem. Older mode-locking literature was not exhaustively checked.
scientific_limitations: Reduced positive rational rotation numbers, one-slope contracted rotations, and 0<lambda,b<1 only. Polynomial boundary formulas themselves are known; only vertical monotonic inversion and the universal vertex law are claimed as new. No uniform-in-denominator or irrational-rotation result is asserted.
title: Exact fixed-translation rational tongues and universal vertex slopes for contracted rotations
